key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities across sectors
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite surging unemployment, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences sharp depreciation ('trapdoor opens'), raising import costs and commodity-linked equity volatility
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year correction, with Victoria hit hardest on unemployment
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags structural fiscal pressure, reinforcing tax reform debate
Gold exploration sector active: Aurum (155g/t hit), Zenith (WA corridor), Auric (Munda), Rio2 (Peru copper) drive small-cap momentum
Cap raise activity surges to $2.7B, signalling capital-hungry junior miners and speculative risk
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/consumer discretionary sentiment

sectors.trend: Gold exploration names (Aurum, Zenith, Auric, Rio2) showing strong drill results; however, cap raise flood ($2.7B) signals dilution risk. Iron ore/coal muted amid China-US geopolitical tension.
sectors.implications: Selective small-cap gold upside vs. dilution risk in juniors; majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) under pressure from AUD weakness and softening China demand signals.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish bias despite unemployment spike supports net interest margins but raises credit-loss concerns as 50%+ of renters struggle financially. Bond yield climb pressures equity valuations.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face rising NPL risk; bond-heavy funds (SGF.AX, HUB.AX) pressured by rising yields.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom driving electricity demand but creating 'energy bust' risk for grid infrastructure; energy security becomes policy priority.
sectors.implications: Energy generators (AGL.AX, CGP.AX, INC.AX) and grid infrastructure names gain structural tailwind; watch gas/LNG pricing (WES.AX, SXR.AX).

sectors.trend: Housing correction (largest in 40 years) and renter stress weigh on consumer confidence; Star casino suspension hits gaming. Single-parent penalty debate signals policy headwinds.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy/rent pressure; consumer staples (WOW.AX, WES.AX) relatively defensive; gaming (STAR.AX) remains suspended.

sectors.trend: Medicare data breach prompts AI safety legislation debate; US AI chip race (Nvidia, AMD, Intel) continues but limited direct ASX exposure. Small-cap tech (Micro-X) in weekly runners.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) remain defensive anchors; ASX tech exposure limited but AI infrastructure spend supports A2M.AX, XRO.AX peripherally.

key_themes: RBA rate pincer: hiking into recession risk, squeezing household balance sheets
AUD depreciation cycle: import inflation vs. commodity exporter revenue boost
Housing correction: 40-year high drawdown, Victoria worst-hit, renter stress at 50%+
Bond yield surge: fourth straight ASX losing week, 'will bonds crash stocks' question
Fiscal sustainability: Intergenerational Report 2026 flags tax reform urgency
Geopolitical risk: Ukraine-Russia escalation, China-US friction
Gold exploration momentum vs. junior cap raise dilution risk
Energy transition: data centre demand vs. grid capacity constraints

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hiking into rising unemployment (stagflation risk)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (WES.AX, CSL.AX); underweight rate-sensitive growth; monitor RBA statement for pivot language.
Hedge AUD exposure; favour commodity exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) whose USD revenue benefits; avoid import-heavy consumer names.
Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor building society (GRB.AX, LVH.AX) credit quality; favour rental-yield defensive REITs.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Rising bond yields compressing equity valuations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in bond funds; favour earnings-driven equities over multiple expansion; watch 10-yr GBA yield vs. ASX earnings yield spread.
Maintain 10-15% allocation to gold (GSG.AX, RGL.AX) and energy (WES.AX, SXR.AX) as hedges.
Avoid pre-announcement cap raise names; favour funded explorers with >12-month cash runway; use ASX runners list selectively.

opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith WA, Auric Munda) plus AUD weakness and geopolitical risk support gold pricing; small-cap discovery premium intact.

opportunities.recommendation: Add commodity exporters benefiting from AUD depreciation
opportunities.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' boosts USD-denominated revenue for iron ore, coal, LNG majors; China demand floor intact despite geopolitical noise.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in energy infrastructure and generators
opportunities.rationale: Data centre boom creates structural electricity demand; grid upgrade capex cycle supports AGL, CGP, and infrastructure names.

defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year housing correction underway; renter stress at 50%+ threatens occupancy and rent growth; building society credit risk rising.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity beta with short-duration bonds and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth straight ASX losing week on rising yields; 'will bonds crash stocks' risk elevated; gold provides uncorrelated hedge.
$2.7B cap raise torrent signals dilution; many names lack funded runway; select only those with >12-month cash and clear catalysts.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Rising bond yields, AUD weakness, and RBA hawkish bias create headwinds. Fourth consecutive losing week suggests momentum is negative. Watch for RBA statement language and next CPI print. Gold and commodity exporters outperform; REITs and rate-sensitive growth lag.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots on unemployment data. Intergenerational Report 2026 may catalyse tax reform, supporting fiscal credibility. Housing correction nearing midpoint; energy transition capex provides structural support. Key risk: stagflation if RBA over-tightens. ASX 200 likely range-bound until rate path clarity.

AUD/USD trajectory and RBA intervention risk
China stimulus / demand signals for iron ore and coal
ASX earnings season (Q3 FY27) starting late Oct

Iron ore (62% Fe) and LNG spot prices
Core CPI and underlying inflation trend
